lines.text: Point one: keep moving. Point two: do not lean on the pump housing.
Wells stay when people do. You stayed. Adequate.
Three crooked apprentices and every one of them can read a gravity line. I am insufferable about it.
The cisterns fill by evening now. Look at the seals. I look every morning.
You smell of drill grease and permit paper. The wells notice.
You asked what the keeper needed before you touched anything. Rarer than rain.
And the grazers. Whoever scares the herd drinks from my cisterns last.
